edges.reason: owner is initialised from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner to stage a new owner.
transferOwnership writes the caller supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to take over the owner role.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner and clears newOwner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] from the caller context.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller context.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller context.
approveAndCall lets an untrusted caller set allowance and reach an arbitrary spender contract.
approveAndCall performs an unguarded external call into the spender before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on the caller.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards to an arbitrary token contract with the return value unchecked.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub on both balances[from] and the allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd computes a + b which is the overflow sensitive arithmetic operation.
safeSub computes a - b which is the underflow sensitive arithmetic operation.
_newOwner parameter feeds the newOwner state variable in transferOwnership.
Parameter a is an operand of safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of safeAdd.
tokens parameter determines the amount moved by transfer.
to parameter is the recipient written in transfer.
spender parameter is stored in allowed by approve.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter determines the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
spender parameter selects the external contract invoked via receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded into the receiveApproval external call.
Local c in safeAdd is the result of the guarded addition.
Local c in safeSub is the result of the guarded subtraction.
